title: RBI Proposed Revamped Business Correspondent (BC) Framework
summary: RBI creates two distinct BC tiers — BC-BOs and BC-BTs — and abolishes Business Facilitators by September 30, 2026.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Proposed Revamped Business Correspondent (BC) Framework. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI issued draft guidelines introducing a two-tier Business Correspondent structure to strengthen rural financial inclusion: **BC-Banking Outlets (BC-BOs)** and **BC-Banking Touchpoints (BC-BTs)**.
**BC-BOs**: Fixed-location units operating min 4 hours/day, 5 days/week, offering full services (account opening, cash, KYC) with fixed + variable pay.
**BC-BTs**: Flexible-hour touchpoints for small cash/remittances paid via variable incentives.
**Abolition of BFs**: Business Facilitators category abolished; all existing BFs must transition to BC structure by Sept 30, 2026.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
